question: When did British dethrone the Nawab of Awadh by saving administration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1856 AD**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• British dethrone the **Nawab of Awadh** in **1856 **AD.
 
• Britishers annexed Awadh under Governor-General **Lord Dalhousie(1848-1856).**
 
• The **Nawab of Awadh** at this time was **Nawab Wajid Ali Shah **who ruled Awadh from 1847-1856.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lord Dalhousie, under the **Doctrine of Lapse policy**, deposed Nawab of Awadh.
 
• It was one of the causes of T**he Revolt of 1857**.
 
• The doctrine of Lapse states that Indian Princely states will be lapsed to British in the** absence of natural successor** and under **any misrule** by the kingdom.
